name: Morgan's light corps (Southern Army detachment)
troop_source: Cowpens article: Morgan reported about 800; other estimates up to ~1,900 (contested); 1,000 used.

rows.label: Winchester (rifle company assembles)
rows.quote: assembled them at Winchester on July 14

rows.label: Arrives at the siege of Boston (Cambridge)
rows.note: Article says he arrived at Boston; the Cambridge camp is the siege lines. The 96-man rifle company marched about 600 miles in 21 days.

rows.label: Fort Western, Kennebec (expedition departs)
rows.quote: set out from Fort Western on September 25, with Morgan leading the advance party

rows.label: Pointe-Lévi, opposite Quebec
rows.quote: On November 9 the expedition finally reached the Saint Lawrence at Pointe-Levi
rows.note: Article names the expedition, not Morgan, on this date. He led the vanguard of the main body, so he was with it; less sure.

rows.label: Battle of Quebec (captured)
rows.quote: Morgan took command of the force, and he successfully overcame the first rampart
rows.note: Captured after being trapped in the city; prisoner until exchanged January 1777.

rows.label: Saratoga: Freeman's Farm
rows.quote: On September 19, at Freeman's Farm, they ran into the advance

rows.label: Saratoga: Bemis Heights
rows.quote: Morgan was assigned command of the left (or western) flank
rows.note: Date given as Oct. 7 in the same article.

rows.label: Resigns, returns home to Winchester
rows.quote: allowed to resign on June 30, 1779, and returned home to Winchester
rows.note: Resignation date; arrival home date not stated.

rows.label: Hillsborough: given command of light infantry
rows.quote: given command of the light infantry corps on Oct. 2
rows.note: Article says he met Gates at Hillsborough and received command on Oct. 2; the meeting itself is undated.

rows.label: Charlotte: meets Greene
rows.quote: Brigadier General Daniel Morgan reported for duty to Greene's headquarters at Charlotte

rows.label: Pacolet River camp
rows.quote: By Christmas Day, Morgan had reached the Pacolet.
rows.note: Left Charlotte area heading west on Dec 21 with about 600 men.

rows.label: Battle of Cowpens
rows.quote: Morgan decided to stand and fight rather than continue to retreat
rows.note: Quote is from the Cowpens article about the night of Jan 16 at Hannah's Cowpens; battle date Jan 17 from same article.
